title: Giant skeletons dug up in excavations of monumental earthworks

tellings.quote: The excavations particularly associated with the monumental earthworks giant skeletons. Those accounts are repeated over and over and over again that in the excavation there's a giant skeleton dug up sometimes seven feet sometimes eight sometimes even nine feet in height.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher, says that 19th-century accounts of digging into huge ancient earthen mounds in the United States report giant skeletons over and over again, some seven, eight, even nine feet tall. He points to old records such as early papers of the Smithsonian, the US national museum, the Bureau of American Ethnology, a government office that studied Native American peoples, and 19th-century archives at Emory's library. If true, it would change how we picture the people who lived in ancient America.
